import json

html = """<your html here>"""  # replace this line with your actual HTML string

soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "lxml")
products = []

    products.append({'product_name': product_name, 'price': price})

print(json.dumps(products))

from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json

html = """Your HTML goes here"""

soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'lxml')  # Parse the HTML
products = soup.find_all('article', class_='product_pod')  # Find all product elements

data = []
for product in products:
    name = product.h3.a['title']  # Extract product name
    price = product.select('.price_color')[0].get_text()  # Extract product price
    data.append({'product_name': name, 'price': price})

print(json.dumps(data))  # Print the JSON array of objects
